citations.quote: Conversion is usually at the holder’s option, although occasionally conversion may be mandatory on a specified future date.
All convertible debt securities must, prior to the issue thereof, be approved by the Exchange and the Exchange should be consulted at the earliest opportunity as to the requirements which will apply.
